QUOTE: `save_permission` (`permission_persister.cpp:227`) writes a pattern into the project YAML under `permissions.allow` or `permissions.deny`. It is a no-op if the pattern is already present.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer describes persisting a pattern to the project YAML, but it never names config.local.yaml. It also never contrasts that with an in-memory add_permission call.
